Warranties and GAP income (loss), net decreased $0.7 million to a loss of $0.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to income of $0.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily as a result of a revised estimate of the present value of the proceeds we expect to recover.

Software and IT costs decreased $0.5 million or 82.3% to $0.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $0.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily as a result of more efficient targeted software use as well as renegotiating and right-sizing our Software and IT contracts.

Warranties and GAP income (loss), net decreased $1.1 million to a loss of $0.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to income of $0.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, primarily as a result of a revised estimate of the present value of the proceeds we expect to recover.

Software and IT costs decreased $1.3 million or 79.0% to $0.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from $1.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, primarily as a result of more efficient targeted software use as well as renegotiating and right-sizing our Software and IT contracts.

We anticipate that our existing cash and cash equivalents, the Delayed Draw Facility, and UACC's Warehouse Credit Facilities will be sufficient to support our ongoing operations and obligations for at least the next twelve months from the issuance date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
Subject to market conditions, we plan to securitize finance receivables originated by UACC through asset-backed securitization transactions.

On October 15, 2026 we pledged an additional $11.7 million of our retained beneficial interest in the 2026-2 securitization transaction as collateral under the Risk Retention Financing Facility, and received proceeds of $11.7 million, with expected repurchase dates ranging from January 2030 to September 2033 at the initial closing date.
